source.title: The 5 rules of email security. Save yourself from being hacked
source.description: "The British have a favorite dish - fish and chips, and the Kremlin hackers - mail and phishing. Email has long been a universal key to all accounts, and phishing helps to bypass the protection of the mail service by attacking the weakest link: the user. Recently, with the help of such attacks, the COLDRIVER and COLDWASTREL groups associated with the Russian special services successfully compromised the email accounts of a number of public figures and organizations - and gained access to sensitive documents. To avoid this in the future, this simple 5-point instruction on how to protect email from phishing was written down."

editorial.why_selected: Five concrete email-security rules from a digital-security hotline expert, framed around the phishing campaigns that target journalists and activists.
